description: This file defines a React functional component 'UsersActivityChart' which renders a line chart showing active users over time, using the 'recharts' library. It includes a prop type definition for passing data and loading state, as well as a fallback 'EmptyChart' component when no data is available.

methods.name: EmptyChart
methods.description: A React functional component that displays a message indicating no data is available when the chart has no data to display.

methods.name: UsersActivityChart
methods.description: Main React functional component that renders a responsive line chart showing active user data, with conditional rendering based on loading state and data availability.
